about.name: Coach Cedric Standard
about.title: DL
about.bio:
Coach Cedric Standard is a proven 3-4 specialist with 16 years of coaching experience at South Grand Prairie High School. Known for a disciplined, film-first approach, Coach Standard develops intelligent, technically sound players who make an impact on every down.

If you're looking to elevate your game on the defensive side of the ball and compete at the next level, Coach Standard's coaching is where that journey starts.

hero.headline: South Grand Prairie High School's Football Coach
hero.subline: Personalized defensive football coaching that turns potential into performance.

services.title: 3-4 Defense Installation
services.description: Full 3-4 system installation — formations, assignments, stunts, and blitz packages tailored to your personnel.

services.title: Film & Opponent Scouting
services.description: Tendency charting, defensive game-planning, and film breakdown sessions that give your defense the edge before kickoff.

services.title: Defensive Line Technique
services.description: Hand placement, leverage, pass rush moves, and gap discipline for DL players who want to dominate at the line of scrimmage.
